title: Q-ULTRA-deploy_health-2: Verified deploys out of bounds: restructure: repair the deploy path that failed verification
body:

**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** closed

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: restructure: repair the deploy path that failed verification. A deploy whose live code differs from its commit means the loop that ships is not closing.

size: M

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T23:11:19Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T02:42:29Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
